tiers.label: Install & inspect
tiers.reach: Install/stage the scaffold and read its documentation.

tiers.label: Onboard & run Tasks
tiers.reach: Complete onboarding and run authorized Tasks locally, with Tier 0 prerequisites.

tiers.label: Full operation
tiers.reach: Operate the roadmap and perform required Task close-out, with Tier 0 and Tier 1 prerequisites.

entries.label: GitHub repository and local checkout

detection.description: Check the target worktree and canonical github.com origin; other hosts/remotes need procedural confirmation.

entries.impact_if_missing: There is no identified adopter worktree in which to install/stage the scaffold.
entries.remedy: Create/select the GitHub repository and its local non-bare checkout; confirm the adopter root and origin.

entries.label: Git

detection.description: Detect the executable and report its version.

entries.impact_if_missing: The installer cannot inspect the checkout or stage scaffold files.
entries.remedy: Install Git and put it on PATH; on Windows use Git for Windows.

entries.label: Bash 3.2+ (Git Bash on Windows)

detection.description: Check Bash >= 3.2; on Windows confirm Git Bash if the version output does not identify MSYS.

entries.impact_if_missing: The Bash installer and workflow helpers cannot run on the supported shell baseline.
entries.remedy: Install Bash 3.2 or later; Windows requires Git for Windows including Git Bash.

entries.label: jq

detection.description: Detect the executable and report its version.

entries.impact_if_missing: JSON-dependent scaffold helpers cannot inspect GitHub records.
entries.remedy: Install jq and make its executable available on PATH.

entries.label: GitHub CLI (gh)

detection.description: Detect the executable and report its version.

entries.impact_if_missing: The kit cannot query or operate on the adopter's GitHub work records.
entries.remedy: Install GitHub CLI and make gh available on PATH.

entries.label: gh authentication and repository access

detection.description: Read active user authentication and target repository metadata; substitute owner/repo from the checked origin.

entries.impact_if_missing: GitHub work records cannot be read reliably, even though public installer acquisition can be anonymous.
entries.remedy: Have the owner authenticate gh (for example, gh auth login) and verify repository permissions and connectivity; the diagnostic never signs in or refreshes credentials.

entries.label: ChatGPT Codex desktop app

detection.description: Confirm the owner can open and use Codex in the desktop app; app installation is not detected.

entries.impact_if_missing: Onboarding, coordination and development are unsupported with CLI/IDE alone.
entries.remedy: Prepare the required desktop app and use its Codex surface for this project.

entries.label: Prepared specification context

detection.description: Read the supplied material and run check-spec-handoff.py when available; a presence check is advisory, not a quality judgment.

entries.impact_if_missing: Onboarding lacks a reviewable goal and specification handoff for planning.
entries.remedy: Prepare/read the material and name missing goal, intended users, scope, non-goals, constraints, acceptance criteria and unresolved questions; the owner decides how to proceed.

entries.label: Adopter Codex project

detection.description: Confirm the adopter Git root is the desktop project's primary folder and the chat uses that root.

entries.impact_if_missing: The desktop workflow has no confirmed adopter execution context.
entries.remedy: Create/select the adopter Codex project, attach its repository root and confirm the local chat's working directory.

entries.label: Scaffold on the remote default branch

detection.description: Read the current default branch and its scaffold instruction anchor; resolve placeholders from metadata, not stale tracking refs. This is not full installation proof.

entries.impact_if_missing: Onboarding P0 cannot proceed to GitHub changes; new Tasks may start without the scaffold.
entries.remedy: Review and land the scaffold on the remote default branch through the normal owner approval process, then verify P0's exact adoption evidence.

entries.label: GitHub Projects permissions

detection.description: Inspect X-OAuth-Scopes: read:project for queries and project for writes (project includes read). Unexposed/non-classic permissions require procedural confirmation.

entries.impact_if_missing: Required-by-default roadmap queries or creation/updates cannot run; a recorded scoped exception may apply.
entries.remedy: For stored gh credentials the owner can run gh auth refresh -s project; environment tokens or other credential types need their own permission update. Never refresh automatically or treat scope detection as write consent.

entries.label: Projects board or recorded scoped exception

detection.description: Read the applicable board/Task evidence or a durable scoped exception for environmental inability or explicit owner decline; neither is inferred by this diagnostic.

entries.impact_if_missing: Required Task close-out remains pending without the exact Project item's Kind Task and both authorized dates, or its exception.
entries.remedy: Obtain separate board/date authorization and verify close-out, or cite the environmental-inability/explicit-owner-decline exception on relevant Epic/Tasks. Pending consent and date-only defer/decline are not exceptions.
